title.en: Local evidence for a host agent
title.zh: 給主代理使用的本地證據

description.en: A local-first CLI and MCP server. The host agent collects, searches, previews, and exports. Muse does not take over, and nothing is published.
description.zh: 本地優先的 CLI 與 MCP 伺服器。主代理負責收集、搜尋、預覽與匯出。Muse 不接管，也不發布。

headline.en: See the exact text before sharing.
headline.zh: 分享之前，先看精確文字。

lede.en: MetaMuse CLI keeps permitted social posts, comments, media, and subtitles as sourced evidence. A host agent such as Claude Code or Codex writes the questions and the copy. Muse is a collaborator, not the harness.
lede.zh: MetaMuse CLI 把獲准使用的貼文、留言、影音與字幕收成有來源的證據。Claude Code、Codex 這類主代理負責寫問題與文案。Muse 是協作者，不是主控。

notes.en: Not affiliated with Meta, Facebook, or Muse

alt.en: Terminal preview of a packet: the exact text that would be shared, one url_token redaction, and the SHA-256 digest. The token is shown as [REDACTED].
alt.zh: 終端機上的資料包預覽：將被分享的精確文字、一筆 url_token 遮蔽，以及 SHA-256。權杖顯示為 [REDACTED]。

caption.en: Exact packet text, one redaction and its digest. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 精確資料包文字、一筆遮蔽與 SHA-256。閱讀純文字紀錄。

label.en: MCP tools, same core as the CLI
label.zh: MCP 工具，與 CLI 共用核心
init 之後的 SQLite 綱要

title.en: A pile of posts is not evidence, and a draft is not a publish button.
title.zh: 貼文不是證據。草稿不是發布。

body.en: The host agent needs a local place for permitted posts, comments, media, and subtitles, with the source method kept as it was. Search should cite an exact revision. A share packet should show the exact text, the redaction counts, and a digest before anything leaves. Partial imports must stay partial. MetaMuse does that bookkeeping. It does not write the copy, and it does not publish.
body.zh: 主代理需要一個本地位置，存放獲准的貼文、留言、影音與字幕，並維持原來的來源方式。搜尋要引用精確版本。分享用的資料包在離開機器之前，要出示精確文字、遮蔽次數與 SHA-256。部分匯入必須維持部分。MetaMuse 做這些紀錄。它不寫文案，也不發布。

intro.en: Every step below is a real metamuse command. The host agent decides the question and the wording.
intro.zh: 下面每一步都是真正的 metamuse 指令。問題與用詞由主代理決定。

body.en: Read a local file. Bad rows are rejected one by one. The job ends partial instead of pretending the file was complete.
body.zh: 讀取本地檔。壞列逐列拒絕。工作以部分結束，不把檔案說成完整。

body.en: Find text inside one project. Each hit cites an item revision and names the collection method.
body.zh: 在單一專案裡找文字。每筆命中都引用一個項目版本，並寫出來源方式。

body.en: Build the exact text that would be shared. Count redactions. Record the SHA-256. Do not send it.
body.zh: 組出將被分享的精確文字。計算遮蔽次數。記下 SHA-256。先不送出。

body.en: Save the host's draft with those citations, then export a local bundle. The manifest lists file hashes. Nothing is uploaded.
body.zh: 連同引用一起保存主代理的草稿，再匯出本地套件。清單列出檔案雜湊。沒有上傳。

heading.en: One core, then the file stays put
heading.zh: 核心只有一個。檔案留在原地。

intro.en: CLI and MCP call the same application. The draft never becomes a post.
intro.zh: CLI 與 MCP 呼叫同一個應用。草稿不會變成貼文。

note.zh: 只讀 import_roots 裡的路徑。

note.en: One SQLite workspace for every entry.
note.zh: 每個入口共用一個 SQLite 工作區。

caption.en: The host agent writes the question and the copy. MetaMuse stores evidence and runs bounded actions.
caption.zh: 主代理撰寫問題與文案。MetaMuse 保存證據並執行有界動作。

intro.en: The same application serves the CLI and the MCP server. The Skill in the repository is a neutral guide: if the backend is missing, it must say so and stop.
intro.zh: 同一個應用同時服務 CLI 與 MCP 伺服器。儲存庫裡的 Skill 是中性指引：後端不在時必須說明並停止。

body.en: Text, CSV, JSON, JSONL, subtitles, and local media. A rejected row keeps its error. Seven bad lines do not erase seven good ones, and the job does not become complete.
body.zh: 文字、CSV、JSON、JSONL、字幕與本地影音。被拒的列留著錯誤碼。七列壞資料不會抹掉七列好資料，工作也不會變成完整。

body.en: Exact substring search inside one project. A hit names the revision, the collection method, and the upstream method from the file. file_import is not rewritten as manual.
body.zh: 在單一專案裡做精確子字串搜尋。命中會標出版本、收集方式，以及檔案裡的上游方式。file_import 不會被改寫成 manual。

body.en: packet prepare renders the exact text, the redaction counts, and the digest of that text. The frame on this page shows one url_token redaction. Preparing a packet does not send it.
body.zh: packet prepare 呈現精確文字、遮蔽次數，以及該文字的 SHA-256。本頁畫面有一筆 url_token 遮蔽。準備資料包並不會送出。

body.en: The host writes the question. An explicit fixture backend is available for offline checks and reports fixture_passed. Open and send stay ineffective until a human grant exists. LIVE is not verified.
body.zh: 問題由主代理撰寫。離線檢查可明示選用 fixture 後端，並回報 fixture_passed。在人類授權之前，開啟與送出維持無效。LIVE 尚未驗證。

title.zh: 主代理已經寫好的草稿

body.en: draft save stores the supplied text and the citations the host passes in. It does not call a model, and it does not add a persona, a formula, or a call to action.
body.zh: draft save 保存提供的文字，以及主代理傳入的引用。它不呼叫模型，也不加入人設、公式或行動呼籲。

body.en: bundle, jsonl, markdown, text, and csv stay on disk. A bundle manifest lists each member hash and a redaction notice. The CLI warns that nothing was published or uploaded. There is no publish tool.
body.zh: bundle、jsonl、markdown、text、csv 都留在磁碟。套件清單列出每個成員的雜湊與遮蔽說明。CLI 會警告沒有發布或上傳。沒有發布工具。

title.en: The installed CLI, on a synthetic workspace.
title.zh: 已安裝的 CLI。合成工作區。

intro.en: A synthetic journey: setup, queue, search, packet, human approval, fixture questions and a follow-up, draft, export, MCP and Skill. Real Alacritty frames are captured at 2× density and cropped to content; every frame links its plain-text transcript.
intro.zh: 合成資料的完整流程：設定、佇列、搜尋、資料包、人類核准、fixture 問答與追問、草稿、匯出、MCP 與 Skill。真實 Alacritty 畫面以 2 倍像素密度擷取並裁到內容；每格都連結純文字紀錄。

alt.en: CLI init, offline and fixture config, and doctor capability rows.
alt.zh: CLI 初始化、offline 與 fixture 設定，以及 doctor 能力列。

caption.en: Offline setup. The config selects the fixture backend; doctor lists capabilities and worker_available=false. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 離線設定。設定檔選用 fixture 後端；doctor 列出能力與 worker_available=false。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Accepted, queued, worker_available=false; run once; partial, 7 committed, 7 rejected, and rejection codes.
alt.zh: accepted、queued、worker_available=false；執行一次後為 partial，7 筆寫入、7 筆拒絕，並列出錯誤碼。

caption.en: Accepted is queued with no worker. One foreground worker pass leaves 7 committed, 7 rejected and a partial job. Read transcript.
caption.zh: accepted 表示排隊，沒有 worker。前景 worker 執行一次後，7 筆寫入、7 筆拒絕，工作維持 partial。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Search hit with an exact item revision, Chinese snippet and source labels.
alt.zh: 搜尋命中包含精確項目版本、中文片段與來源標籤。

caption.en: One hit cites its exact item revision. Its source labels remain file_import and synthetic_fixture. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 一筆命中引用精確項目版本。來源標籤維持 file_import 與 synthetic_fixture。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Packet preparation, exact rendered text, one url_token redaction and SHA-256.
alt.zh: 準備資料包、精確文字、一筆 url_token 遮蔽與 SHA-256。

caption.en: The exact text that would be shared, with access_token=[REDACTED], one redaction and a SHA-256 digest. Nothing is sent. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 將被分享的精確文字，含 access_token=[REDACTED]、一筆遮蔽與 SHA-256。沒有送出。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Muse open approval preview with the exact action digest
alt.zh: Muse 開啟預覽與精確操作雜湊

caption.en: A grant-free open returns E_SCOPE_REQUIRED with the operation, exact digest and request to review. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 未附授權的開啟指令回傳 E_SCOPE_REQUIRED，列出操作、精確雜湊與待審查請求。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Packet preview, human-only permit approval and accepted open
alt.zh: 資料包預覽、人類專用核准與獲接受的開啟請求

caption.en: The host agent has no approval tool: a person previews the packet and approves the exact digest. The operator review shows expiry and one use; open is then accepted. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 主代理沒有核准工具：人類預覽資料包，再核准精確雜湊。操作者審查列出到期時間與一次使用；開啟請求接著獲接受。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Fixture Muse question, worker refresh, progress reply and closure
alt.zh: fixture Muse 問題、worker 更新、進度回覆與結束

caption.en: A host-written question and approved packet go to the offline fixture backend, not a real Muse account. The cached reply retains backend=fixture, mock=true and research_complete=false; the exchange closes as needs_more_data. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 主代理撰寫的問題與已核准資料包送往離線 fixture 後端，並非真實 Muse 帳號。回覆保留 backend=fixture、mock=true、research_complete=false；此輪以 needs_more_data 結束。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Fixture follow-up in the same discussion with incomplete research
alt.zh: 同一個 fixture 討論的追問與未完成研究標記

caption.en: A second neutral question stays in the same fixture discussion. Its reply remains progress with research_complete=false, and the exchange again closes as needs_more_data. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 第二個中性問題沿用同一個 fixture 討論。回覆仍是 research_complete=false 的進度，此輪也以 needs_more_data 結束。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Host-written draft citing the item and two Muse observations
alt.zh: 主代理草稿引用項目與兩筆 Muse 觀察

caption.en: The host saves its own text with the item revision and observations from both fixture exchanges. No generation call. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 主代理保存自行撰寫的文字，引用項目版本與兩輪 fixture 討論的觀察。沒有呼叫生成模型。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Local bundle manifest, fixture labels and no-publication warnings
alt.zh: 本地套件清單、fixture 標記與未發布警告

caption.en: The local bundle manifest lists file hashes and retains the fixture labels. Stderr says nothing was published or uploaded, and redaction is a guard. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 本地套件清單列出檔案雜湊並保留 fixture 標記。stderr 寫明沒有發布或上傳，遮蔽只是一道防護。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Official MCP client, 15 tools and attached-worker collection
alt.zh: 官方 MCP 用戶端、15 個工具與附掛 worker 匯入

caption.en: The official stdio client lists 15 tools, submits a local synthetic file and polls the attached worker to completion. The server reports worker_available=true. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 官方 stdio 用戶端列出 15 個工具、提交本地合成檔，並輪詢附掛 worker 至工作結束。伺服器回報 worker_available=true。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Packaged Skill export and resulting local files
alt.zh: 打包 Skill 匯出與產生的本地檔案

caption.en: Skill export writes SKILL.md and three references to the named host directory. Read transcript.
caption.zh: Skill 匯出把 SKILL.md 與三份參考寫入指定的主代理目錄。閱讀純文字紀錄。

title.en: One package. The host stays in charge.

intro.en: There is no second orchestrator inside the tool. The Skill tells the host how to call the backend, and it refuses to invent a result when the backend is down.
intro.zh: 工具裡沒有第二個編排器。Skill 告訴主代理如何呼叫後端；後端不在時，它拒絕編造結果。

items.en: Humans grant access. The model cannot.
items.zh: 存取由人類授權。模型不能。

items.en: A share is an exact digest, or it is not sent.
items.zh: 分享要對上精確 SHA-256，否則不送。

items.en: Labels stay source-faithful: backend, mock, research_complete.
Partial is never shown as complete.
items.zh: 部分結果不會顯示成完整。

intro.en: Review the exact action before sharing. Fixture replies keep their labels, and the host writes the draft.
intro.zh: 分享前審查精確操作。fixture 回覆保留原有標記，草稿由主代理撰寫。

title.en: A person approves the exact action

body.en: A missing grant returns an approval preview. The human-only permit approve command binds the exact digest, expiry and use limit; there is no MCP approval tool. The synthetic demo scripts the operator input.
body.zh: 缺少授權時回傳核准預覽。人類專用的 permit approve 綁定精確雜湊、到期時間與使用次數；MCP 沒有核准工具。合成示範以腳本輸入操作者核准。

body.en: A CLI import can be accepted and queued without a worker. The MCP server starts one attached worker by default; --no-worker opts out. Both use the same workspace executor lock.
body.zh: CLI 匯入可在沒有 worker 時接受並排隊。MCP 伺服器預設啟動一個附掛 worker；--no-worker 可停用。兩者使用同一個工作區執行鎖。

body.en: The packet frame shows one url_token replaced with [REDACTED]. The tool also says redaction is not a privacy guarantee. Read the text before you share a bundle.
body.zh: 資料包畫面把一筆 url_token 換成 [REDACTED]。工具也寫明遮蔽不是隱私保證。分享套件之前要自己讀過文字。

body.en: The Skill tells a host how to use an installed CLI or MCP server. Without a reachable backend it reports unavailable and stops; it cannot fabricate execution.
body.zh: Skill 告訴主代理如何使用已安裝的 CLI 或 MCP 伺服器。沒有可連線的後端就回報不可用並停止，不能編造執行結果。

intro.en: Python 3.12, managed by uv. This example puts the workspace outside the checkout; the CLI uses its readable output without --json.
intro.zh: Python 3.12，由 uv 管理。範例把工作區放在檢出目錄之外；CLI 使用不帶 --json 的可讀輸出。

body.en: Creates the workspace database and the offline config.
body.zh: 建立工作區資料庫與離線設定。

body.en: Lists capabilities. Live doctor is unavailable.
body.zh: 列出能力。live doctor 尚未提供。

title.en: The README status, row by row.
title.zh: 逐列對應 README 的狀態。

intro.en: The same four states as the README. Muse LIVE is not verified. Approval, fixture exchanges and the attached worker have offline tests; no real account integration is claimed. Pre-alpha; nothing is released.
intro.zh: 與 README 相同的四種狀態。Muse LIVE 尚未驗證。核准、fixture 討論與附掛 worker 已有離線測試；不宣稱真實帳號整合。預覽版，尚未發行。

works.en:
Local import
implemented with offline tests
Local files and text. The local import path rejects URLs before a job exists; approved remote inputs use their own collector.
works.zh:
本地匯入
implemented with offline tests
本地檔案與文字。本地匯入路徑會在建立工作前拒絕 URL；已核准的遠端輸入使用各自的收集流程。

works.en:
Local media and subtitles
implemented with offline tests
Optional ffprobe; tests requiring it skip when absent.
works.zh:
本地影音與字幕
implemented with offline tests
ffprobe 為選用；缺少執行檔時，相關測試會跳過。

works.en:
Search
implemented with offline tests
Project-scoped search over imported evidence.
works.zh:
搜尋
implemented with offline tests
在專案範圍內搜尋匯入的證據。

works.en:
Packets
implemented with offline tests
Selection file to an exact pre-share preview.
works.zh:
資料包
implemented with offline tests
由選取檔產生精確的分享前預覽。

works.en:
Drafts
implemented with offline tests
Host-supplied text; no generation call.
works.zh:
草稿
implemented with offline tests
主代理提供文字；不呼叫生成模型。

works.en:
Exports
implemented with offline tests
Five local formats; no publish or upload.
works.zh:
匯出
implemented with offline tests
五種本地格式；不發布、不上傳。

works.en:
Muse lifecycle with the fixture backend
implemented with offline tests
Open, send, read and close offline; derived records retain backend=fixture, mock=true, research_complete=false.
works.zh:
fixture 後端的 Muse 流程
implemented with offline tests
離線開啟、送出、讀取與結束；衍生紀錄保留 backend=fixture、mock=true、research_complete=false。

works.en:
Muse standard-VM transport
implemented with offline tests
Strict Noise key/nonce verification, durable trust and bounded wake/redial. AT-038 and AT-043 LIVE have not run; CVM is unsupported.
works.zh:
Muse 標準 VM 傳輸
implemented with offline tests
嚴格驗證 Noise 金鑰與 nonce、持久化信任紀錄，並有界喚醒與重連。AT-038、AT-043 尚未執行 LIVE；不支援 CVM。

works.en:
MCP stdio
implemented with offline tests
Fifteen tools; stdout is protocol, logs go to stderr.
works.zh:
MCP stdio
implemented with offline tests
15 個工具；stdout 僅傳協定，日誌送至 stderr。

works.en:
MCP attached worker
implemented with offline tests
metamuse mcp starts one worker; --no-worker opts out. One workspace executor holds the OS lock.
works.zh:
MCP 附掛 worker
implemented with offline tests
metamuse mcp 啟動一個 worker；--no-worker 可停用。同一工作區只有一個執行者持有 OS 鎖。

works.en:
Approval previews and metamuse permit approve
implemented with offline tests
Human approval of the exact action; no MCP approval tool.
works.zh:
核准預覽與 metamuse permit approve
implemented with offline tests
人類核准精確操作；MCP 沒有核准工具。

works.en:
Remote media (B12)
implemented with offline tests
Exact-action approval preview and human permit approve. OFFLINE and FIXTURE evidence; AT-040 LIVE has not been run.
works.zh:
遠端影音（B12）
implemented with offline tests
精確操作的核准預覽與人類執行的 permit approve。已有 OFFLINE 與 FIXTURE 證據；尚未執行 AT-040 LIVE。

works.en:
Facebook posts (B13)
implemented with offline tests
One operator-approved post per job, rendered in sandboxed Chromium through a policy-checked local proxy. Tested only on synthetic loopback pages; requires the facebook extra and Playwright Chromium. Human approval uses metamuse permit create; Facebook approval preview is not wired yet. No real-account run.
works.zh:
Facebook 貼文（B13）
implemented with offline tests
每個工作限一則操作者核准的貼文，以沙盒 Chromium 經過本地政策檢查代理呈現。僅以合成的本機回環頁面測試；需要 facebook 選用依賴與 Playwright Chromium。由人類執行 metamuse permit create 核准；Facebook 核准預覽流程尚未接上。未曾使用真實帳號執行。

works.en:
CI
implemented with offline tests
GitHub Actions check runs the offline gates, sandboxed loopback Chromium browser tests (browser skips fail CI), and wheel smoke on every PR and main push; required status check on main since 2026-10-14.
works.zh:
CI
implemented with offline tests
GitHub Actions check 在每個 PR 與 main push 執行離線檢查、沙盒 Chromium 本機回環瀏覽器測試（跳過瀏覽器測試即失敗）及 wheel smoke；自 2026-10-14 起為 main 的必要狀態檢查。
